name: liquid-glass-notification
title: Liquid Glass Notification
description: Two stacked glass notifications sit at the bottom of a photo backdrop, each with an app icon, title, message and time. Hovering or clicking the top one expands it from a slim row into a card with a preview image.
use: You want a rich notification that can open to show an attachment or preview without leaving the page.
avoid: The expanded card is a fixed 410px wide, and the preview is a hardcoded remote image.
a11y: Expanding relies on pointer hover or click on a div with no keyboard focus, so keyboard users cannot open it. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two slim dark glass cards stacked with a small gap, each showing a rounded gradient app icon, a bold title, one or two lines of white text and a time at the right. When open, the top card grows tall and reveals a mountain lake photo beneath its text.
behaves: At rest the notifications are slim rows. Pointing at or clicking the top card expands it downward with a spring to reveal the preview image, then it shrinks back. The lower card stays compact throughout.
customise: Titles, messages, timestamps, icon gradients and the preview image URL are hardcoded in the JSX. Size, blur, shadow, glow and the expandable flag come from the glass card props.
weight: moderate: Two blurred glass cards with a displacement filter and a remote preview image.
demo: Two alerts, one from UI-Layouts, both reading New components are available for you, with a mountain lake photo.
issues: The second app's title is an SVG wordmark that renders as an unreadable blob at this size.
The preview image loads from a remote URL, so the expanded card can show a gap offline.
polishWhy: Convincing frosted rows and a smooth expand; the second title is illegible.
